label: Aquaponic MQTT to MySQL
info: Menyimpan telemetri node-perikanan, node-hidroponik, dan node-energi ke tabel MySQL terpisah.

name: Validasi dan Route ke Tabel
Buat 3 Tabel
func:
const queries = [
`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aquaponic_fisheries (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 group_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
 node_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
 sequence_no BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 uptime_ms BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 machine_status ENUM('ON','OFF') NOT NULL,
 do_mg_l DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
 ph DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL,
 water_temp_c DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
 ammonia_mg_l DECIMAL(7,3) NOT NULL,
 aerator_status ENUM('ON','OFF') NOT NULL,
 received_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
 PRIMARY KEY (id),
 INDEX idx_fisheries_time (received_at),
 INDEX idx_fisheries_group_node (group_id,node_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB`,
`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aquaponic_hydroponics (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 group_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
 node_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
 sequence_no BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 uptime_ms BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 machine_status ENUM('ON','OFF') NOT NULL,
 ph DECIMAL(4,2) NOT NULL,
 tds_ppm DECIMAL(8,1) NOT NULL,
 water_temp_c DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL,
 water_level_pct DECIMAL(5,1) NOT NULL,
 pump_status ENUM('ON','OFF') NOT NULL,
 received_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
 PRIMARY KEY (id),
 INDEX idx_hydroponics_time (received_at),
 INDEX idx_hydroponics_group_node (group_id,node_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB`,
`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS aquaponic_energy (
 id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
 group_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
 node_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
 sequence_no BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 uptime_ms BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
 machine_status ENUM('ON','OFF') NOT NULL,
 pv_power_w DECIMAL(10,1) NOT NULL,
 battery_soc_pct DECIMAL(5,1) NOT NULL,
 battery_voltage_v DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL,
 load_power_w DECIMAL(10,1) NOT NULL,
 energy_kwh DECIMAL(14,3) NOT NULL,
 received_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
 PRIMARY KEY (id),
 INDEX idx_energy_time (received_at),
 INDEX idx_energy_group_node (group_id,node_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB`
];

node.status({fill:'blue',shape:'dot',text:'membuat tabel'});
return [queries.map(query => ({topic:query,payload:[]}))];

name: Setelah import: buka node MySQL dan isi host, user, serta password
